hook: This is an article about fiction that should not exist, assembled as a catalogue of reviews, wiki edits and forum threads about works nobody ever made. Go in expecting a slow list rather than a monster. Read the containment procedures closely, and keep half an eye on the numbers that keep coming up in each entry.
whyItMatters: SCP-2747 is built around a striking idea it names outright: an anafabula, a cluster of story elements that, once a fiction contains enough of it, wipes out the story that holds it. The file treats layers of narrative as a real structure, where a story erased inside a story can drag the outer one out of existence too. Instead of describing that effect from a safe distance, it arranges the document so that you watch the effect play out on the page.
thingsToNotice:
Every invented work in Appendix A circles the same dark, central absence: a black horned mountain the traveller dies before reaching, a coal-black tome whose fragments are missing even from the game's code, an obsidian emblem held by a villain nobody sees, a cold silent core the dreamer wakes before entering, an absent Stranger whose testimony never arrives. Count the parts and six plus one keeps recurring, echoing the 7,000-artist watchlist; the anafabula, the file says, always shows up as the antagonist.

Then the payoff. The procedures keep pointing you to Appendix B, where the Foundation's own experiment supposedly pinned the anafabula down, and under its heading there is nothing at all. Euclid has been struck through to Keter and Green to Black, one sentence about the 2008 start breaks off mid-thought, and the rules forbid the anafabula's traits from ever arising in real life. Read together, the implication is that the Foundation described the anafabula in its own report, and that report, being one more layer of story, just consumed itself, with our layer possibly next.

related.note: A footnote cites it as one of the anomalies whose observations fit the layered-narrative model.
Named in the same footnote as further support for that model.
